facts.name: Jerome Kaszubowski
facts.role: Clerk of Circuit Court and Comptroller

contact.contact_note: General clerk/personnel email/fax and departmental civil/records contacts separately labeled. Contact page lists common main number for departments; civil page also gives direct numbers. Official records office is Government Center second floor at590SouthCommerce, distinct from courthouse physical address. Office hours8:00AM–4:30PM; no personal assistant or private judicial email inferred.

records_access.summary: Official-records search uses Acclaim; court records use Civitek. Clerk describes attorney registration for enhanced images, and identifies internet results as informational rather than certified official records.

chambers_communications.summary: Use published clerk/civil contacts for administrative assistance. Clerk staff provides limited filing assistance; source lists courthouse civil services and current public closing time4:30PM.

facts.summary: Clerk identity, separate courthouse/mailing/recording locations, civil contacts and three county navigation resources retained.

review_scope.collected: Official clerk home/contact/civil/search pages and official elections county directory; resource-target checks retained separately.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Identity/contact blocks, public hours, practical record access and registration; civil jurisdiction wording preserved as an unverified source observation.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Fee schedules, eviction/small-claims litigation packets, case records and unrelated criminal/family materials.

conflicts.statement: Contact page uses clerk@highlandsclerkfl.gov and clkbusor@highlandsclerkfl.gov; older court-access text uses clerk@hcclerk.org and records page clkbusor@hcclerk.org. Preserve both without asserting forwarding or selecting authority.

source_observations.civil_amounts: Civil page states small claims$8000 or less, county civil$8000 but less than$30000, circuit civil$30000 or more. Preserve exact original; not verified as current jurisdiction guidance and not promoted as operative rule.
source_observations.officials_judge: Elections directory names Anthony L.Ritenour while circuit county profile labels Vacant; county assignment reconciliation pending.

gaps: No clerk assistant or personal-only email published in reviewed sources; resource-check failures retained separately.
